name: Leads Store Database Contact Form7
author: melonwebstudio

sections.description:
Leads Store Database Contact Form7 is a simple yet powerful plugin that saves all your Contact Form 7 submissions to your WordPress database. Stop losing important leads from failed email deliveries or lost messages.

This plugin provides a dedicated section in your WordPress admin dashboard to view and manage all your form submissions in one place.

Key Features:

  • Saves Submissions: Automatically saves all Contact Form 7 form submissions to the database.
  • Centralized Leads Management: View all your leads in a clean, easy-to-use table within the WordPress admin area.
  • Filtering Options: Filter leads by form name, date range, or a combination of both to quickly find what you need.
  • Data Export: Export your filtered or all leads to a CSV file with a single click.
  • Lead Details Popup: Click on any lead to see a detailed view of the submission data in a convenient modal popup.
  • Pagination: Navigate through your leads easily with built-in pagination.
  • Simple & Lightweight: Designed to be lightweight and not slow down your website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the leads-store-database-contact-form7 folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. A new menu item, “CF7 Submissions”, will appear in your WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace the default Contact Form 7 email functionality?

No, this plugin works alongside the default email functionality. It saves a copy of the submission to your database, so you’ll still receive the email as configured in Contact Form 7.

Can I export all the data?

Yes. You can use the export feature to download all or filtered submissions as a CSV file.

Where do I find the leads after a form is submitted?

After activation, you will see a new menu item called “CF7 Submissions” in your WordPress admin sidebar. All leads are listed there.

Do I need to set up anything in Contact Form 7?

No. The plugin works automatically once activated. It hooks into the Contact Form 7 submission process without any extra configuration.
